messages:
lina (product): Heads-up: need a compact rollout plan for PriorityRouting v1 -> v2 cutover. This is more than just a flag; customers want clear opt-in, rollback windows, and a perf-cost target. Can we agree on slices and an A/B measurement approach today?

rahul (eng): Suggestion: split rollout into 4 guardrails:
1) tenancy opt-in pilots (EU customers first)
2) internal + dogfood traffic shadowing
3) 10% random tenants with slow-start
4) selective promote by tenant based on quality.

kai (sre): Add safety: automated kill switch, per-tenant slow-start cap, and a fallback route to legacy. Also require that we have a clear indicator for noisy tenants (excess tokens) to exclude them from metrics.

tess (eng-ml): We'll run online A/B for quality using paired requests (same prompt to v1 and v2) for a subset of traffic. Metrics: embed-sim, latency delta, and token-usage delta. We'll keep a 24h rolling window for decisions.

jon (sales): Two customers (beanbox and nova-eu) want to opt-in to pilot but need an explicit rollback SLA: 4h rollback guarantee. Can we commit?

marco (customer-success): For pilots, we'll require a weekly sync and a feedback form that maps comments to request ids + tenant. Also suggest we provide a short KB about expected regressions during pilot.

lina (product): Proposed launch criteria (minimum):
- Perf: p95 increase <= 150ms vs v1
- Error: < 0.2% increase in 5xx
- Quality: embedding sim >= 0.92 avg on validation set
- Cost: average per-token delta <= +12%

rahul (eng): Flag schema example:
```
{
  "flag":"priorityrouting_v2",
  "stages":[
    {"name":"canary-internal","pct":0.5,"tenants":["internal-*"]},
    {"name":"pilot-eu","pct":3,"tenants":["opt-in","eu-pilot"]},
    {"name":"rand-10","pct":10,"rules":{"slow_start":true}},
    {"name":"gradual","pct":50,"rules":{"min_qps":5}}
  ],
  "fallback":{"on_latency":"route_v1","on_error":"kill_flag"}
}
```

kai (sre): Automated rollback triggers:
- if p95 delta > 200ms for 15m -> rollback
- if 5xx > baseline + 0.4% for 10m -> rollback
- if per-tenant token spike > 3x baseline for 10m -> exclude tenant from metric set

tess (eng-ml): A/B plan: shadow full-precision for 12h and compute sim-score. If quantized model falls < 0.9 sim on a tenant for 6h, promote to fp automatically.

jon (sales): We'll sign the two pilots with a clause: pilot is opt-in and customer can request rollback within the SLA window; we must confirm the rollback flow and contact list.

lina (product): Action items:
- Product: prepare pilot addendum + rollback contact template (lina)
- Eng: implement flag + slow-start enforcement + export (rahul)
- SRE: setup kill-switch, metric exclusions, and dashboard tile (kai)
- Eng-ML: implement paired A/B logging + promotion automation (tess)
- CS/Sales: finalize pilot tenants + comms (marco/jon)

rahul (eng): I'll open a perf harness and PR for flag by EOD.

kai (sre): I'll draft the runbook and schedule a checkpoint during pilot.

deploy-bot: Rollout plan created: priorityrouting_v2 plan_id=pl-9012 creator=lina start=1718241600

marco (customer-success): Signing off on feedback form template, will attach to pilot invite.

lina (product): Great. Let's keep updates here. Aim to start pilot on Wed next week.

rahul (eng): PR #4310 opened: feature/priorityrouting-v2 + perf-tests https://github.com/redwood-inference/pilot/pull/4310

kai (sre): Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/priorityrouting-v2-runbook

marco (customer-success): Pilot tenants confirmed: beanbox, nova-eu

lina (product): Thanks team. If any risk appears (cost or quality), flag immediately.
